title: Bank Return Timing Table for Design Studio Selections Option Deposit Payments
content:
A payment that comes back long after it was posted carries a late-return addition on the Design Studio Selections returned payment fee. The addition is set by the calendar days from the date the returned payment was posted to the date of its return:

| Calendar days from posting to return | Late-return addition (USD) |
|---|---|
| More than 10 | 20.00 |
| More than 3, up to 10 | 10.00 |
| 3 or fewer | Nothing |

**Records read.** The posting date of the option deposit payment carrying the returned receipt number, and the date of the return (the date Calloway was notified) on the returned-payment entry.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical payment posted 2026-06-01)**

| Date of return | Days | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-04 | 3 | Nothing |
| 2026-06-05 | 4 | 10.00 |
| 2026-06-11 | 10 | 10.00 |
| 2026-06-12 | 11 | 20.00 |
